draft_notes: Apr-Jun: mild, ideal for walking/cycling/sightseeing/watersports. Sep-Oct: shoulder season, warm days cooler evenings, harvest festivals, fewer crowds. May: wildflowers, meltwater rivers/waterfalls peak, beach weather starts. Jun: perfect walking/cycling weather, alpine season opens. Jul-Aug: hot/dry/sunny, peak activity season, higher prices. Dec-Feb: snowshoeing, 'Christmas card' mountain scenes, coldest/wettest elsewhere.

Apr-May: ideal Sahara camping temps, nights lose chill. Oct-Nov: cooler, easier exploring, date harvest in M'Zab Valley. Jan-Mar: winter sun + spring wildflowers, mild coast, comfortable desert temps. Sep: heat eases, touring resumes, warm Mediterranean water without crowds. Dec: mild winter sun, good for photography, occasional Atlas Mountains snow. Avoid Jun-Aug: Sahara dangerously hot (40C+), most desert tours close.
Jun-Oct: dry, mild, sunny -- the stated best window. Jul: coolest/driest, ~23C highs in Luanda, typical tour departure month. Jun-Sep: optimal for southern Angola / Namibe coast.

Nov: largest icebergs, spring mating/nesting, unpredictable weather. Dec: rising temps, 24hr sunlight, more wildlife. Jan: penguin chicks/seal pups, relatively warm, humpbacks arrive. Feb: warmest month, peak whale season, Antarctic Circle crossings possible. Mar: season end, fewer visitors/lower prices, continued whale watching.

Dec-Feb: summer warmth, north gets very hot, Patagonia high season (peak crowds/prices). Mar-Apr: autumn foliage in Lake District, wine harvest, Apr best for Iguazu. May-Aug: more pleasant temps overall, southern Patagonia inaccessible (snow/ice), Jul busy/expensive locally. Jun-Aug: peak rainfall at Iguazu, boosts falls but may close trails. Nov-Feb: long sunny days for southern Patagonia. Spring/autumn: fewer tourists, less wind.

Sep-Oct: best, long sunny mild days, autumn colors. Jun: hiking, balmy/dry ~26C. Apr-May: culture/history, flowers, passes open. Jul-Aug: high-altitude hiking despite heat, water sports. Avoid Jan-Feb (extreme cold), Nov-Dec (snow, low season).

Sep-Nov: spring, wildflowers WA, best for walking. Mar-May: temps dropping, east coast dry/clear. Jun-Aug: pleasant, chilly evenings, best for Northern Australia. Apr: whale watching starts Victoria. Aug-Sep: WA wildflowers. Apr-May: Great Barrier Reef, best water clarity. Avoid Nov: Gold Coast schoolies.

Jan-Mar: snow-guaranteed winter sports. Apr-May: walking/cycling season, festivals. Jun: wildflowers peak. Jun-mid Oct: high peak climbing window. Jul-Aug: summer beauty, Salzburg festival. Sep: alpine cattle-return festivals. Oct: autumn colors, walking/cycling. Dec-Mar: winter sports, Christmas markets. Shoulder (Apr-May, Sep-Oct) recommended over Jul-Aug crowds.

Apr-Jun: hiking/culture, wildflowers, mild. May: peak season starts, Baku Flower Festival. Sep-Oct: excellent weather, lower heat, harvest festivals, fewer crowds. Mar: Novruz Bayrami (note: many shops close). Jul: warmest, music festival. Oct: foliage, pomegranate festival. Avoid Jan-Feb (coldest), Jul-Aug (40C heat), Nov (quiet/start of winter).

Nov-Mar: dry season, pleasantly warm, best window. Dec: peak, warm sunny days cooler nights, Dhaka ~25C. Avoid Mar-May (40C+ heat, storms), May-Oct (monsoon, heavy rain). Nov caveat: leftover coastal showers/cyclones.

Nov-May: sunny/dry, warmth kicks in by Feb. Feb: great weather, lower prices between peak seasons. Mar-Jun: whale sharks, Ruta Maya canoe race (Mar). Jun: LobsterFest starts. Avoid Dec-Jan (peak/crowded/pricey), Feb-mid Apr (cruise congestion), Apr-May (humidity), Aug-Oct (rainiest, hurricane risk Jun-Oct).
Nov-Feb: dry but dusty (harmattan wind). Dec-Mar: cooler/more pleasant despite dust. Jan: Vodoun Festival (Jan 10, Ouidah). Aug: alternative -- cooler, clear skies, no harmattan, for southern Benin.

Oct-Dec: best, driest/brightest. Mar-May: spring, wildflowers, trekking season. Sep-Nov: autumn, clear skies, festivals, wildlife. Jan-Feb: winter, snowy photography, but road closures. Avoid Jun-Aug monsoon, though Jul warmest for cultural (non-hiking) trips.

May-Oct: dry, clear skies, less disruption. Apr-May: fewer crowds/lower prices, landscape still fresh. Oct-Nov: dry, warming, spring. Jun-Jul: dry/sunny but very cold highlands (-20C nights). Aug: highest crowds/prices, book early. Sep: excellent, minimal rain. Avoid Nov-Mar (rainy, travel disrupted), esp Jan-Mar (highest rain/landslide risk). Feb-Apr: festival season (Carnival, Easter) but road closures.

Aug-Oct: dry winter, big wildlife herds at waterholes, hot days/cold nights. Nov-Mar: green season, dispersed wildlife, pleasant, storms, migratory birds. May: good combo with Victoria Falls, dry season starts. May-Aug: best for Okavango Delta (high water). Jul: most popular, cool/dry, book ahead. Sep: often called best overall for big game.

Dec-Mar: hot sunny summer, pricier, Feb=Carnival (crowded/expensive). Apr-Jun: shoulder, pleasant/warm, fewer crowds, good value, trekking. Jul-Oct: dry season, best wildlife viewing Pantanal/Amazon. Sep-Oct: low season, great wildlife spotting, quiet beaches. May: dry season starts, Pantanal drying. Jul-Aug: best for jaguar spotting Pantanal.
Feb-Mar: driest, National Day Feb 23. Mar-late Oct: high 20s-low 30s C. Jul: Sultan's birthday (15th), fireworks/parades. Late Oct-Jan: slightly cooler but wettest, may restrict Temburong access.

Jan-Mar: snowshoeing/winter walking Rila Mountains, fewer tourists. Apr-May: snow at elevation, valleys warm, wildflowers, rain (pack waterproofs). Jun: hiking, low 20sC, craft fairs. Jul-Aug: peak heat in valleys, cooler mountain forests, only window for 2 highest peaks. Sep-Oct: pleasant Mediterranean-like temps, grape harvest. Nov: colder, most resorts not open till Dec.

Jan-Feb: little rain, blue skies, good for coast. Mar-Apr: rising temps/humidity, minimal rain. May-Jun: monsoon begins, heavy coastal rain. Jul-Sep: soggy but lush/green, fewer crowds. Oct-Nov: transitional, decreasing rain, Oct = 'beautifully green'. Dec: clear skies, good beach window before holiday peak.

Nov-Feb: best, cooler/drier, lowest rainfall, best wildlife viewing, best roads. Dec-Feb: core dry window, harmattan wind (dust). Jan: best month to climb Mount Cameroon (dry, mild). Dec: busiest month of year -- book ahead. Rains May-Nov, heaviest from Jul.

Jun-Aug: best overall, warm, long days, festivals, everything open -- busiest/priciest. May: before summer crowds. Sep-Nov: fall foliage, comfortable, fewer crowds. Dec-Mar: best snow/winter sports, skating, Northern Lights.

Nov-Jun: best overall, comfortable (20-29C), low rain. Dec-Mar: dry/breezy, best for beach lovers/winter escapees. Feb: Carnival on all islands, Mindelo's the most spectacular. Mar-Apr: peak humpback whale migration off Boa Vista. Jul-Oct: secondary season, sporadic manageable showers.

Mid Dec-Apr: high season, driest, flamingo breeding season, harvest festivals, best diving/windsurfing, ~80F. Feb-Jun: excellent weather + fewer crowds. May-Aug: shoulder, warm/still waters, avoids peak crowds, slight rain increase from late Jul. Outside hurricane belt, stable year-round.

Dec-Apr: high season, best overall, balmy (75-85F), vibrant events/festivals. Mar-Jun: hotel rates drop, still great weather -- popular sweet spot. May & Nov: shoulder, pleasant + slightly more rain. Jun-Nov: low season/hurricane season, fewer tourists, better prices.

Sep-Nov & Mar-May (shoulder): best overall, mild, fewer crowds, great hiking/wine tasting. Dec-Feb: peak season, best for hiking/rafting/beaches, priciest, book ahead. Nov-Feb: Patagonia most accessible. Jun-Aug: best skiing (Lake District/Central Chile), also good for visiting the north with fewer tourists.

Mar-May & Sep-Nov: best overall, warm/dry, lighter crowds than summer. Spring: blossoms, pleasantly warm, cool evenings. Autumn (esp south): little rain, comfortable sightseeing. Avoid Chinese New Year (late Jan/early Feb) and Golden Week (Oct 1-7): huge crowds, higher prices, closures. Winter: fewer crowds, budget-friendly.

Jul-Oct: dry season, best overall weather, least rainy/sunniest, calm seas, low humidity. Oct-Jan (esp mid-Nov-mid-Dec): red crab migration -- 60 million crabs cover the island, a signature draw distinct from the best-weather window. Nov-Feb: high season (peak crowds). May-Aug: low season, drier days still, quieter.

Aug-Feb (dry season core May-Oct): best overall, cloudless days, busy lagoons (snorkel/dive/canoe). May-Oct: trade wind season, steady SE winds, best kitesurfing. Nov-Apr: doldrum season, warmer/humid, sporadic winds. Dec-Feb: best diving/snorkeling (calm+clear). Nov-early Mar: best birdwatching.

Dec-Mar & Jul-Aug: dry seasons, best overall, warm/clear/ideal for Amazon-Andes-coast. Dec-Jan: sunny + festivals but pricier/crowded. Feb-early Mar: pleasant weather, holiday rush eased. Cartagena: best Dec-Apr specifically. Rainy season: fewest crowds/cheapest, good for indoor-heavy trips.

Apr-Nov (drier/fresher) broadly; Jun-Oct: cool/dry peak season, mild enough for extended outdoor time -- but priciest/most crowded. May-Sep: dry season proper, low humidity, best national park visits. Jun-Aug: dry skies, calm seas, humpback whale calving off Moheli. Nov-Apr: rainy, hot/humid, roads can become impassable.

May-Sep or Jan-Feb: best overall, driest. Jun-Sep: peak season, driest/coolest, best gorilla trekking/wildlife safaris (Odzala-Kokoua). Jan-Feb: short rain break, also good. North of country: wettest during this same Jun-Sep window (opposite pattern). Mar-May & Oct-Nov: low season, greener/more secluded, wetter esp north.

Jun-Aug: peak, max sunshine/min rain -- but priciest/most crowded. Apr,May,Sep,Oct: shoulder, warm+dry balance, lower prices, fewer crowds -- best overall value. Jul-Oct: humpback whales visible from Rarotonga foreshore. Dec-Apr: cyclone season, frequent afternoon storms (often brief).

May-Jun & Sep-Oct (shoulder): best overall, mild, fewer crowds/lower prices -- late Sep especially good (summer-warm water, way fewer people). Jun-Aug: hot/sunny peak, festival season, but crowded beaches. Spring: waterfalls/national parks at their best. Dec: Christmas markets draw visitors despite low season.

Nov-Apr: dry season, best overall, comfortable-warm, sunny. Apr: widely cited as best single month -- 24-29C, crowds ease after Easter. Winter (Dec-Feb): warm, low humidity, minimal rain, but priciest/most crowded. May: fewer crowds (Vinales etc), rains just starting. Avoid Sep-Oct: hurricane season.

Dec-Apr: best overall, dry/sunny, ~30C -- Carnival wraps up in March with a big street parade. May-Nov: budget season, up to 50% cheaper, no hurricane exposure. Sep-Oct: best coral spawning viewing for divers. Jul-Aug: music/cultural festival season, hotter.

Apr-early Jun & Sep-Oct: best overall, warm/quiet beaches, ideal for both seaside + inland exploring. Spring: blooming landscapes, hiking + festivals. Jul-Aug: hot/dry, busiest beaches. Sep: 'second summer' minus crowds; Oct: cooler, great for sightseeing + vineyard hopping. Nov-Mar: mild, low season, fewer crowds.

Mar-May & Sep-Oct: best overall, good weather, moderate crowds, plenty of festivals -- Sep/May specifically cited as best. Spring: Prague reawakens, blossoms. Jun-Aug: lively, warm, but Prague gets very crowded. Winter: cheapest, Christmas markets popular, but many sights close for ~2 months after New Year's.

Jun-Aug: best overall, long daylight, 59-68F, ideal hiking -- crowded/pricier. Apr-May & Sep-Oct: shoulder, similar appeal for less -- Sep/early Oct especially good, still long days, smaller crowds. Nov-Dec: Christmas beer (from Nov 5) + markets, cozy Copenhagen atmosphere.

Dec-Apr: dry season, best overall, driest/brightest -- Jan-Feb ideal beach+rainforest combo, but priciest/busiest. May-Jun & Nov: green season shoulder, fewer crowds/lower cost, more lush. May-Nov broadly: cheapest, rainier but still very visitable, especially early on.

Nov-Mar (esp Nov-Feb): best overall, cool/dry, ideal for desert (Lake Assal/Lake Abbe) + coastal exploring. Dec-Jan: peak whale shark season, Gulf of Tadjoura -- a signature draw. Oct-Jan: best diving/snorkeling visibility. Mar-Apr & Oct: shoulder, manageable heat, fewer crowds. Avoid May-Oct: fiercely hot (40C+).

Dec-Apr: high season, best overall, no storm risk. Feb-Apr: most reliable -- low rain, calm seas, comfortable temps, Feb driest. Feb: Carnival, big cultural draw. End of Oct: World Creole Music Festival. Mar-Sep: best turtle nesting (leatherback/hawksbill/green). Jun-Nov: rainy, hurricanes most likely Aug-Oct.

Nov-Apr (esp Dec-Apr): dry season, best overall, sunny, low humidity, 70-82F -- priciest around Christmas/spring break. Feb: Carnaval (Sundays). Mar: Isle of Light Music Festival (electronic/dance). Jul-Oct: best rates/discounts, daily afternoon showers, higher humidity.

Jun-Sep & Dec-Jan: most popular overall, though visitable year-round given equatorial location. Highlands/Andes: Jun-Sep dry, best hiking. Coast: Nov-Jan warmest/driest. Amazon: Jun-Oct dry season, more wildlife visible at riverbanks. Galapagos: Dec-May calm seas/sun/light wind; Jun-Nov nutrient-rich water draws more marine life.

Oct-Apr: best overall, cooler, comfortable days/cool nights, guaranteed sun. Jan-Feb: busiest -- Sep,Oct,Mar,Apr slightly warmer with fewer crowds. Mar-May: Khamsin winds bring dust/sandstorms. Ramadan (Mar or Apr, varies): affects business hours. Jun-Aug: hottest but best Red Sea diving/snorkeling (also good Apr-Jun & Sep-Nov for warmer water + fewer winds).

Nov-Apr: dry season, best overall, clear skies, warm, good for hiking/city/cultural sites. Jan-Feb: sunny, lower humidity, cooler, peak season without Christmas/Easter crowds. May & Nov: shoulder, lush/fewer crowds, good for photographers. May-Oct: best surfing. Aug-Oct: hurricane season, watch conditions.

Dry seasons Jun-Aug & Dec-Feb: best overall, sunny, little rain. Bioko Island/Malabo: driest Nov-Feb, ~25C, sea turtle nesting on southern beaches. Mainland: best Jun-Aug specifically. Dec-Feb: thousands of butterflies gather at Playa de Arena Blanca (Bioko) for mating season -- notable wildlife spectacle.

Nov-Feb: best overall, mild (20-30C), good for highlands+coast. Asmara (capital): best Oct-Mar, 15-25C. Massawa (coast): best Nov-Feb, bearable heat, Red Sea beaches/history. Highlands (Keren, Adi Keyh): best Dec-Feb. Sep: Meskel festival (Orthodox Christian, finding of the True Cross) -- visually spectacular. Avoid May-Sep: oppressive heat, up to 45C on coast.

Jun-Sep: best overall, fine weather for cities+outdoors -- Jul-Aug warmest (70s-80sF) but priciest/most crowded. May & Sep: best balance, mild (18-22C), fewer crowds. Apr-May: castles/estates touring season starts, prices not yet peak. Sep-Oct: golden foliage. Nov-Feb: snow, ski resorts open.

May-Sep (winter, dry): best overall, warm days/chilly mornings-evenings, little rain, best wildlife viewing (animals gather at waterholes). May: single best month, dry/mild/clear skies. Oct-Apr (summer): green/lush, hot/humid/wet, best birdwatching (migratory species present, native species in full plume). Apr-May & Sep-Oct: shoulder, good for Malolotja Nature Reserve.

Oct-May: dry season, best overall, warm/sunny, best hiking/wildlife/sightseeing. Sep-Dec: scenery at its best -- lush/green post-rain, sky clear of haze. Jul-Aug: wettest, avoid, esp for hiking/camping. South Ethiopia: longer rains, best Oct-May. Omo Valley: best Nov-Mar or Jun-Sep (heavy rain late Mar-Jun). Oct-May is also peak season/pricier; rainy season much cheaper.

Nov-Feb (summer): best overall, long days, clear skies, warmer, prime wildlife viewing -- broader window Oct-Apr also workable. Nov-Feb: penguin breeding/hatching season, top penguin encounters. Mar-Apr (autumn): best whale sightings. Weather changeable/windy year-round regardless of season -- book cruises/flights early, limited lodging.

May-Sep: best overall, long days, greenest landscapes, best accessibility. Jun-Aug: drier/sunnier (never guaranteed), ~11-12C, up to 20hrs daylight in Jun, all attractions open. Jun & late Aug: better-balanced than peak Jul (fewer crowds/lower prices). Apr-May & Sep-Oct: fewer visitors, more peaceful. Winter: visit for landscapes + Northern Lights chance, not weather.

May-Oct: dry season, best overall, warm/minimal rain, best beaches+underwater world. Jun-Sep: peak, driest, Jul-Aug best weather (~78F) but busiest/priciest. May,Jun,Sep,Oct: shoulder, quieter, still dry. Nov-Apr: wet season, humid, storm risk (except Dec, still busy w/ holiday tourists) -- Feb-Apr good for sightseeing without crowds.

Jun-Aug: best overall for most travelers, warm, near-endless daylight in the north (up to 10wks May-Jul). Dec-Apr: Lapland winter magic, Sami culture, Northern Lights, dog sledding -- Feb-Mar for more daylight. Sep-Oct: best foliage (red maples, golden birches). Northern Lights actually statistically most common Feb, Mar, Sep, Oct (not deep winter).

Mar-May & Sep-Nov: best overall, comfortable temps, fewer crowds. May: favorite month, 61-68F, pleasant nationwide. Jun-Aug: hot/busy, best for beaches/outdoor activities, peak season. Sep-Nov: warm (61-77F), vivid fall color. Winter: cold/quiet countryside (many closures), but Paris lively with cultural events + few crowds.

Aug-Nov (two best stretches: mid-Aug-mid-Sep & early Oct-early Nov): dry season, best overall, clear skies, low humidity, accessible trails. Sep & Oct: driest/sunniest, though hottest (~32C). Jan-Feb/early Mar (Epiphany to Ash Wednesday): Carnival, biggest party in the country, but rainy season. Apr-Jul (peak May-Jun): leatherback turtle nesting.

Apr-Oct (austral winter, dry season): best overall, less humid, balmy temps -- Jun-Aug is high season for Bora Bora etc, sunniest. Nov-May: hotter/more humid/rainier (Dec especially), but low season with fewer people + lower prices. Jul (first two weeks): Heiva i Tahiti festival -- traditional Polynesian dance ('ori Tahiti), major cultural draw. Aug-Nov: humpback whales migrate in to give birth.

May-Sep (dry season, esp Jun-Aug driest): best overall, roads more accessible, best wildlife viewing at water sources. Dec-early Feb: second dry spell -- tropical fruit abundance draws gorillas/elephants to the coast, prime beach wildlife viewing while avoiding heaviest rains. Avoid Apr & Nov: wettest months.

Nov-mid May (dry season, esp Nov-Feb): best overall, sunny, minimal rain, best beaches/wildlife/birdwatching. Oct-Dec: best birdwatching, wetlands lush post-rain, migrant European birds. Dec-Feb: best wildlife safari (thinner vegetation). Nov-Mar: best hiking/nature walks. May: quiet/budget pick, fewer tourists, most places still open.

Late May-Sep: best, warm, active. Jun-Aug: peak, mild (15-20C), near-endless daylight around solstice. May & Sep: shoulder, cooler (9-17C), quiet/cheap, still good cycling. Winters very cold/dark, little tourism.

Jun-Sep: dry season, most reliable weather, best beach/outdoor. Sep-Oct: dry + whale sightings. Nov-Apr: wet season, hot/humid, cyclone risk peaks -- though Nov & Feb-Apr calmer for water activities. Mid Dec-mid Jan: locals return home for holidays, lively.

Jun-mid Sep: best, least cold in mountains, warm (not hot) valleys. Jul-Aug: peak, most reliable sun, warmest (28-29C). May-Jul & Sep: shoulder, Mediterranean sun, fewer tourists, some early-season rain. Dec-Apr: ski season.

Jan-Apr: driest, best underwater visibility (esp Feb-Mar). May-Aug & Nov: best deals/fewer crowds, still good weather. Sep-Oct: quietest/most peaceful. Hurricane season Jun-Nov (strikes uncommon); reliable weather, low rainfall overall.

Mid Dec-mid Apr: dry season, best overall, min storm risk. Apr: best single month (less rain than Mar, sunny/pleasant/not humid). Dec-Feb: high season start, cooler (25-26C). May-Jun: shoulder, warm/pleasant, fewer tourists. Jul-Nov: hurricane season (low risk but present).

Mid Dec-mid Apr: best weather, dry season, festivals. Nov & late Apr: shoulder, fine weather/fewer crowds, still pre/post-hurricane season. Dec-Feb: pleasant, ~73-81F. Jun-Nov: hurricane season, peak Aug-early Oct; fall is cheapest.
Dec-Mar: best, pleasant/mild for sightseeing (16-28C days). Mar-Apr & Oct-Nov: shoulder, favorable balance. Avoid Jun-Aug: extreme heat 40C+, high humidity.

Dec-Apr: dry season, best overall, low rain/high sun, steady trade winds. Jun-Nov: wetter, more humid, brief downpours; Sep-Oct rainiest. Nov & May: shoulder, quieter, good value. May-Jun & Sep-Nov: best value/fewer crowds.
Apr-Jun & Sep-Oct: best, mild, fewer crowds, spring blooms/autumn foliage. Jul-Aug: warmest but crowded/pricier (avg high just 22C). Nov-Mar: cold/wet/gloomy, snow rare; Nov quiet, good for museums.

Mar-Apr: best overall balance, warming into 70sF, lower prices than summer. Apr-Jun: low humidity, ocean warming, good for snorkeling. Jul-Sep: peak beach season, ~30C, occasional late-summer hurricane remnants. Dec-Feb: quiet, best hotel deals. Avoid Oct: wettest month.

Apr-Oct: broad good window. May, Jun, Sep, early Oct: best balance of mild temps + fewer crowds. Jul-Aug: hot (up to 36C), peak crowds, little rain. Winter cold/wet (worse in Mostar/Herzegovina, drier than Sarajevo in summer); ski season Jan-Mar.

Dec-Apr: best, warm/sunny/low rain/low humidity. Jan-Mar: driest, best trade winds. May-Jun & Oct-Nov: shoulder, pleasant + lower prices/crowds. Aug-Nov: rainy/hurricane season, Sep-Oct wettest+most hurricane risk.

Jun-Aug: long dry season, driest/sunniest, best overall. Dec-Jan: short dry season, sweet spot combining dry travel + birding. Rains peak Apr-May. Lake Tanganyika shore ~23C year-round, cooler in mountains. Feb: quietest/cheapest (rainy).

May-Jun & Sep-Oct: best, mild, fewer crowds -- Sep-Oct ("Velvet Season") especially good, wine harvest/Rtveli festival. Apr: spring blooms. Jun-Aug: peak, warm, Tbilisi hot/humid but mountains cooler/drier. Dec-Feb: cold, good for ski resorts.

Apr-Jun & Sep-Oct: best, mild, fewer crowds, spring blossoms/fall foliage. May: standout, ~65-70F, May Day festivals. Jun-Aug: peak season, warm, crowded/pricier. Oct: best leaf-peeping. Nov-Mar: cold/snowy but cheapest, Christmas markets.

Oct-Mar (esp Nov-Mar): best, dry season, cooler/less humid. Dec: sunny, fewer mosquitoes. Jan-Feb: coolest/most pleasant, though Harmattan wind brings haze/dust from Dec. Nov-Mar: best wildlife viewing (elephants Mole park). Sep-Oct: still rainy but good for the north.

Dec-Apr (esp Jan-Apr): best, dry/sunny/warm (~82F), driest Feb-Apr. Apr-Aug: shoulder, fewer crowds, still excellent weather, steady breeze. Sep-Nov: off-season, sporadic rain/higher heat index, but big savings. Outside hurricane belt.

May-Oct broadly warm/dry; spring (Mar-May) & fall (Sep-Oct): best overall balance, comfortable + ideal for sightseeing/hiking -- May is the sweet spot (warm, minimal rain, sunny). Jun-Aug: long sunny days, warm sea, Aug hottest (28C+). Sep-Nov: peak for spotting migratory birds over the Strait. Nov-Feb: best whale/dolphin spotting + cheapest.

May & Sep-Oct: best overall, pleasant, no rain, smaller crowds (except holiday weekends). Apr-Jun & Sep-Oct: warm not stifling, quieter. Jun-Sep: hot/crowded but best nightlife/beach scene. Sep: sea still warm, less company than peak summer. Nov-Feb: colder, city attractions stay open + quiet.

Jun-Aug: best overall, mild, near-constant daylight, most accessible -- hiking/kayaking/whale watching/Ilulissat Icefjord, but mosquitoes in Jul-Aug. Sep: balance of daylight/dark, last cruises, Northern Lights season begins. Mar-Apr: pristine snow, best dog sledding/snowmobiling/skiing. Sep-Mar: Northern Lights window, most vivid in winter.

Mid Dec-Apr: high season, best overall, dry, low humidity, 21-30C. Jan-Mar: busiest/priciest. May & early Jun: sweet spot -- after crowds leave, before rains/hurricane winds arrive. Nov & May: shoulder, brief tropical showers. Jun-Nov: wet season, humid, heavy-but-quick showers.

Dec-May: best, warm/dry, highs mid-80sF. Jan-Mar: coolest/driest. Jan-Apr: high season, best weather + cultural events incl. famous Carnival, best for snorkeling/surfing/hiking La Soufriere/whale watching. Late Nov: showers subsiding, lower rates. Aug-Sep: hurricane season risk; Jun-Jul & Oct-Nov: frequent showers/humidity.

Jan-May: dry season, best overall, cooler, good beach/outdoor conditions. Jan-Mar: cool/dry, incl. Tumon Bay Music Festival (Feb). Apr-Jun: still pleasant, good diving/snorkeling/water sports. Jul-Sep: rainy season peak, highest typhoon risk (possible any month).

Nov-Apr: dry season (verano), best overall -- clear skies, warm days, cooler highland nights, best for Mayan ruins/hiking. Mar: often considered the single best month. Feb: warm/sunny, easier hotel availability than Jan/Easter. May-Oct: rainy season (invierno), afternoon showers, lush, fewer tourists, good for rivers/wildlife. Mid Dec-mid Jan & Easter: highest demand, book early.

Jun-Sep: best, warmest/driest, swimmable sea, long daylight. Sep: excellent balance -- warm, fewer tourists, lower prices. Mar-May: spring blooms, gardens/walking trails, cooler (9-14C). Nov-Feb: worst, short days, most rain, reduced services.

Nov-Apr (esp Dec-Mar): dry season, best overall, cool/low rain, good for hiking/wildlife/beaches. Fouta Djallon highlands: best Dec-Feb, cooler (10-20C). Coastal region: best Nov-Mar, warm/sunny (25-32C). Avoid Jun-Oct rainy season: impassable roads, malaria/dengue risk.

Dec-May: dry season (harmattan winds), best overall, warm/dry though hazy skies. Dec-Jan: least hot of the dry months. Dec-Mar specifically: best for islands, calmer seas, snorkeling/fishing/wildlife. Avoid Jun-Oct rainy season, esp Jul-Sep (Aug rainiest, roads worsen).

Aug-Mar broadly dry-ish; core dry season Feb-Apr: best overall, accessible interior roads, easier wildlife spotting. Sep-Oct: shorter dry spell, fewer crowds, good for Indigenous Heritage Month cultural experiences. Just after rains (early Aug or late Feb): landscape freshest, waterfalls fullest, but pricier. Rainy May-mid Aug & mid Nov-mid Jan.

Dec-Apr: dry season, best overall, warm (26-32C), low rain, outside hurricane season. Feb: driest, best diving visibility (Roatan/Utila). Jan-Jun: good for outdoor adventure generally. May-Nov: hotter/humid, heavy afternoon rain, hurricane risk later in year.

Oct-Dec & Mar-May: best overall, mild/low humidity/clear skies. Oct-Nov: widely considered best, comfortable (~23C), reasonable rates. Mar-May: blooming/festivals. Jun-Sep: hot/humid, typhoon risk. Mid May-early Sep + post-Lunar New Year: cheapest.

May-Jun & Sep-early Oct: best overall, mild, fewer crowds. May: rains recede, warms up nicely. Sep: low-70sF, good balance, grape harvest/wine season. Jul-Aug: peak, hot (80s-90sF), major music festivals (e.g. Sziget). Nov-Dec: Christmas markets/festivities.

Jun-Aug: best overall, Midnight Sun (up to 21hr daylight), all roads/highlands/Westfjords open -- but busiest/priciest. Jul-Aug: all hiking trails open. Apr-May & Sep: cheaper/quieter shoulder, changeable weather, spring wildflowers. Sep-Apr (esp Nov-Feb): best Northern Lights. Apr-Sep: whale watching; May: puffins arrive.

Oct-Mar: best overall, cooler/clearer/ideal sightseeing -- Feb especially good, workable almost everywhere. North/Himalayas: Oct-Mar. Ladakh: Jun-Sep (opposite -- rest of country in monsoon). South: best from Nov once monsoon ends. Festival season Oct-Mar: Diwali (Oct/Nov), Jaisalmer Desert Festival (late Jan-early Feb), Holi (Mar). Apr-May: hot but strong for wildlife viewing.

May-Sep: dry season, best overall, lower rainfall/humidity. Jul-Aug: high season (Euro summer + local holidays), most crowded/priciest. Mar-May, Oct-Nov: shoulder, lower prices/crowds, good trekking weather, best value on Bali/Java/Flores. Papua/Maluku: best Sep-Mar (opposite pattern, heavy rain Jul-Aug there). Ramadan (varies yearly): many services quieter/closed.

Apr-May & Sep-early Oct: best overall, comfortable + fewer crowds than summer. Jun-Aug: sunniest/warmest (~68F, 16-18hr daylight) but peak crowds/prices. Apr: good mix of weather + smaller crowds. Late Sep: calm seas, golden landscapes, best value. Nov-Feb (esp Jan): cheapest, fewer tourists, unpredictable weather, some attractions closed.

Jun-Aug: best, sunny/warm, peak prices. May-Jul: excellent all-round climate without peak crowds. Sep: fewer crowds, lower rates, still mild. Mar-Apr: slowest/cheapest. Note: TT motorcycle races last week May-first week Jun draw huge crowds -- avoid if not interested, seek out if into motorsports.

Apr-May & Sep-Oct: best, mild/comfortable (20-28C), rare rain, landscapes at their best. Spring (esp May): widely regarded best -- green hills, wildflowers, past the holiday crowds. Sep: cooling off, fewer crowds. Dec-Feb: low season, more rain, still mild. Varies by region -- Jerusalem/Tel Aviv/Dead Sea all differ.

Apr-Jun & Sep-Oct: best overall, mild (60-80F), fewer crowds. Fall: vineyard harvests, truffle festivals, seasonal feasts -- food/wine lovers' pick. Apr-Jun & mid-Sep-Oct: best beach months. Oct-Nov: fewer crowds/lower prices, still pleasant. Jul-Aug: hot/crowded/pricey, avoid if possible despite good beach weather.

Dec-Apr: dry season, best overall. Late Jan-early Mar: sweet spot, big rains gone + harmattan cools mornings. South has 2 dry/2 rainy seasons (dry Dec-Apr & Aug); center has one long rainy season Jun-Oct. Shoulder Apr,May,Sep,Oct: mix of sun/showers, fewer crowds, better deals. Avoid Jun-Aug: heaviest rain, flooding risk.

Mid Dec-Apr: best, high season, sunny/dry, 25-30C -- but busiest/priciest, esp Christmas. May & Nov (esp Nov-mid Dec): shoulder, good weather + fewer crowds + better deals. Jun-Nov: hurricane season, humidity peaks Jul, highest hurricane risk late Aug-early Sep. Sep-Oct: best value/cheapest.

Mar-May & Sep-Nov: best overall, mild/clear, cherry blossoms (late Mar-early Apr peak, hanami festivities) and autumn foliage -- but also most crowded. Mid Jan-early Mar (esp Feb): cheapest, low season. Jun-Aug: hot/humid, rainy season early summer.

Jun-Aug: peak, warmest/most reliable weather, busiest. Late May-late Jun & first half Sep: sweet spot -- dry trails, long days, fewer crowds, off-peak rates. Apr-May & late Sep-Oct: cheaper shoulder, still pleasant. Jan: quietest, lowest tourism, easy exploring.

Mar-May & Sep-Oct: best overall, mild (15-25C), wildflowers in spring, good for hiking/Petra/Wadi Rum. Apr or May: often cited as single best months, rain cleared, before summer heat. Jun-Aug: hot, 30C+, higher in desert. Dec-Feb: mild but cold at elevation (Petra/Amman can see snow, freezing nights in Wadi Rum).

May, Jun, Sep: best overall, between summer heat/winter cold. Apr-Jun & Sep-Oct: good sightseeing windows. Jul-Aug: peak season for mountains (escape city heat) but priciest. Sep-Oct: best for Charyn Canyon (too hot in summer). Dec-Apr: cheap/peaceful ski season, Jan coldest (down to -45C some areas).

Jun-Oct: dry season, best overall for wildlife -- Great Wildebeest Migration reaches Masai Mara Jul-Aug, stays through Sep. Jan-Mar: also great, mild/dry/fantastic game viewing, fewer crowds than Jun-Oct. Mid Mar-Jun & Nov-Dec: rainy season, lower prices/fewer crowds, greener landscapes.
Apr-Oct (dry season, esp May-Oct with trade winds): best overall, cooler/less humid, calm seas, good snorkeling/fishing. Dec-May: wet season, cheaper rates, Mar-Apr wettest (~14in rain in Apr).

Jun-Aug: best for festivals/outdoor sightseeing, warm, lively summer festival season -- busy but not overly crowded. Apr-Jun & early fall: milder, fewer crowds, wildflowers, still snow-capped mountains, best for hiking. Nov-Jan: cold, snowy, low season.

Nov-Apr: best overall, cooler days/pleasant nights. Dec-Feb: coolest, 63-71F highs, good for museums/Grand Mosque. Mar-May: manageable warmth (~88F), waterfront walks. Sep-Nov: cooling down, ideal. Shoulder (Apr,May,Oct): fewer crowds. Jun-Aug: scorching, avoid.

Jun-Sep: best overall, dry, good for high-altitude regions/lakes/valleys. Sep: often cited best -- great weather + fewer crowds, mid-70sF. Apr-Jun & Sep-Oct: spring wildflowers / golden autumn, also good. Dec-Feb: ski season (Karakol), uncrowded/cheap. World Nomad Games: biennial in Sep, traditional sports (eagle hunting, kok-boru).

Nov-Apr: dry season, best overall. Nov-Jan: most comfortable, ideal for river cruises/kayaking -- but high season, crowded/pricier. Oct: shoulder, dry weather returns, good deals. May-Jun (early rains): short showers, lush green countryside, still very travelable. Mar-Jun: hottest, up to 35C+.

Apr-Sep: warmest/sunniest overall. Jun-Aug: peak, long daylight (sun up 4:30am-10:20pm mid-Jun), best for beaches/parks -- busiest/priciest. Sep-Nov: standout foliage. Late Nov-early Jan: Riga Christmas markets, good city-break pick despite cold/snow. Apr-May: fewer crowds, lower prices, still pleasant.

Mar-May (autumn) & Sep-Nov (spring): best for hiking/pony trekking, low rain, cool-not-freezing days, lush from summer rain. Oct-Mar: warm but regular rain/mist. Jun-Aug (winter, dry): sunny days great for hiking/horseback, but cold -- Jun-Jul snow on ground, best for skiing (Afriski). Dec-Apr: landscape lushest/greenest.

Nov-Apr: dry season, best overall, more predictable weather/accessible roads. Nov & mid-Feb: best specifically (avoids worst harmattan dust of Dec-early Feb). Feb-Apr: warm/dry, good wildlife viewing, fewer tourists (Feb). Mar-Apr very hot. Avoid May-Oct rains: muddy/impassable roads.

May-Sep: best overall, warm (~75F), open trails, Vaduz summer festivals -- Jun-Aug busiest/priciest. Sep: best single month, mild + less rain + lower prices, harvest festivals/foliage. Dec-Feb (esp mid Jan-mid Mar): best skiing, Malbun resort.

Jun-Sep: best overall, long daylight (17hrs+ in Jun), midsummer Joninės bonfire/sea festivals (late Jun). May-Jun & Sep-Oct: fewer crowds, mild, Sep especially dry, forests turn amber/copper. Winters dark/cold; other seasons changeable.

Jun-Aug: best/most popular, mild-warm, cultural events. Apr-May: pre-peak, blooming countryside, fewer visitors, wildflowers. Sep-Nov: wine harvest season, pleasant + fewer crowds. Nov: Christmas markets begin. Jan-Mar: least busy, good for museums/indoor.

Oct-Feb (esp Oct-Dec): best, sunny/warm/low humidity -- Oct-Dec also peak for foodie/art festivals and travel business events. Jan-Jun: low season, cheaper, Mar-Apr fewest visitors. Avoid May-Oct: typhoon season; Jul-Sep hottest (78-89F).

Apr-Oct: cool/dry season, best overall. Apr-Jun: shoulder, newborn animals, lush green, uncrowded, mid-70sF. Jun-Aug: best weather/road conditions, coolest, peak season though. Sep-early Nov: repeat-visitor favorite, end of dry season. Avoid Jan-Mar: hot/rainy, cyclone risk.

May-Oct: dry season, best overall, cool days/pleasant evenings. Jul-Oct: peak wildlife viewing (animals gather at water sources) + best Lake Malawi snorkeling/diving. May, Jun, Oct: quieter shoulder, still great lake conditions. Avoid Dec-Mar: humid green season, many lodges closed.

Feb-Sep broadly best (regional): West Coast/Penang/Langkawi best Dec-Mar; East Coast best Apr-Oct; Borneo best Mar-Oct. Apr-Jun: sweet-spot crossover, good most places. Cultural highlights: Chinese New Year (late Jan/Feb, Penang/KL parades), Hari Raya Aidilfitri (Ramadan's end, feasts), Deepavali (Hindu festival of lights).

Jan-Apr: dry season, best overall, clearest/calmest water, best diving/snorkeling -- but priciest/busiest. May-Nov (monsoon): budget season, lower costs; late Oct/early May shoulder best value+weather balance. Oct-Nov: whale shark season. Jun-Jul: best surfing + local celebrations.

May-Jun & Sep-Oct: best overall balance -- warm, sunny, fewer crowds than peak summer. Sep especially: fall favorite, warm sea, long sunny days, little rain. Jun-Aug: sunniest/hottest, peak crowds. Mar-May: cooler, good for hiking/sightseeing. Nov-Mar: mild by European standards (10-15C).

Dec-Apr: dry season, best overall. Feb-Mar (also Aug): warm/sunny/low rain, ideal diving/snorkeling/fishing -- Mar best overall (stable weather, low rain, great ocean conditions). Busiest months: Nov, Jun, Mar. Avoid May-Nov wet season, esp Aug-Oct storm risk.

Mid Dec-Apr: dry season, best overall, warm/sunny, vibrant cultural festivities. Mar-Apr: best combo of low rain + good temps. Dry season is peak/pricier -- May-Jun: better deal, still dry/pleasant. Avoid Sep-Nov: heaviest rain.

Nov-Mar (core Dec-Feb): best overall, warm not scorching, manageable for desert/overland travel. Mid Jun-Aug: date harvest season in oases towns, cultural draw. Jan-Feb: watch for Saharan dust/air quality. Avoid May-Jun (40C+ heat) and Jul-Sep (rainy, flood risk in Nouakchott).

May-Dec broadly: cool/dry season, best for hiking/nature/culture. Apr & Oct-mid Dec: most idyllic for beach holidays. Oct: locals' favorite month. Jul-Aug: avoid east coast, strongest winds. Avoid Jan-Mar: wet cyclone season.

Jun-Oct: dry season, best overall, warm/sunny/rare rain, good kitesurfing/sailing. Jun: favorable balance -- dry, comfortable, moderate crowds/costs. Jul-Oct: humpback whale season in the lagoon. Avoid Dec-Feb: hurricane season, hot/humid/rainy.

Dec-Apr: dry season, best overall, virtually no rain -- best for Caribbean coast, Pacific resorts, central highland cities. Riviera Maya: best Nov-Mar. Mexico City: best Nov-Apr, sunnier. Avoid Jun-Nov: wet season south, hurricane risk Caribbean coast Jun-Nov.

Dec-Apr: dry season, best overall, low humidity. Jan-Feb: driest, calmest seas, best diving visibility. Jan-Apr: also Yap Day festivities (early Mar). Nov-Dec: traditional festivals, dances/music/rituals. Sep: wet season low point, quietest/cheapest.

Apr-Jun & Sep-Oct: best overall, pleasant, lush countryside, good for hiking/birdwatching. Apr-May: full bloom, ideal walking weather. May-Sep broadly comfortable. Early Oct: grape harvest + annual Wine Festival, a calendar highlight. Jul-Aug: high season, more tourists. Late autumn-early spring: chilly/overcast/snowy.

Apr-Oct broadly good; Apr & Oct specifically: ideal balmy weather + reduced rates. May: Formula 1 Grand Prix (major draw, but crowded/pricey). Jun-Sep: best beach weather, packed. Sep: Yacht Show. Apr: tennis tournament. Nov-Mar: quiets down, cheaper.

Late May-early Sep (core mid Jun-late Aug): best overall, lush steppe, mild, long days. Mid-Jul: Naadam Festival (archery/horse racing/wrestling) nationwide -- book far ahead, availability tight. Sep-Oct: fewer crowds, golden autumn, Golden Eagle Festival (first weekend Oct, Altai Mountains). Winter: bitterly cold (-30C), not for typical travelers.

Apr-Jun & Sep-Oct: best overall, mild, fewer crowds, coast at its best May/Jun/Sep. Jul-Aug: hottest (30-35C), peak crowds/prices, sea fully swimmable. Dec-Jan: coldest coastal months (~7C nights); Kolašin is the top ski resort in winter.
Dec-Jun: drier season, best overall for northern-hemisphere travelers. Late Jul-early Aug: Cudjoe Head Festival -- best pick for history/culture/festivals despite being outside the dry window.

Sep-Nov & Mar-May (esp May & Sep): best overall, warm not scorching, manageable crowds. Apr: best for Atlas Mountains, lush + still snow-capped peaks. Sep-Oct: mild for cities, comfortable desert, pleasant mountains. Avoid Jul-Aug: often 100F+. Ramadan (dates vary) affects hours/plans.

Apr-Nov: best overall (dry season), avoids wettest Dec-Feb. May: best beaches/World Heritage coastal sites. Apr-Jun & Sep-Nov: best diving/snorkeling visibility. Jul-Oct: best wildlife viewing (dry season) + humpback whale season.

May-Oct: dry season, best overall, mild days/clear skies. Jun-Sep: peak, driest, best Etosha wildlife viewing (concentrated at waterholes), lowest malaria risk. Jul: driest month. Apr, Oct, Nov: shoulder, mild + off-peak. Nov-Apr (wet season): most vibrant colors/landscape.

May-Oct: dry season, best overall, steadier trade winds, clearest snorkeling water (Anibare Bay). Mar-May & Sep-Nov: shoulder, near-identical weather, fewer travelers/lower cost. Oct: sweet spot -- great weather + national holiday celebrations. Avoid Nov-Feb: rainy, strong winds.

Oct-Dec (esp Oct-Nov): best overall, clear skies, easy trekking, good visibility -- also Dasain and Tihar, Nepal's two biggest festivals. Mar-May: spring, rhododendrons bloom, good trekking. Mid-Sep: good weather, avoids main tourist crowd. Avoid Jun-Aug monsoon: obscured mountain views, landslides, many places close.

Jun & Sep-Nov: best overall balance -- good value/quiet/activities, autumn beer & food season. Mar-May: tulip season (peak bloom Apr, very crowded/pricier). Jun-Aug: warmest, best cycling/canal cruises, busiest/priciest. Winter: Christmas markets, canal ice skating if cold enough.

Jun-Oct: dry season, best overall, low humidity, clearest lagoon visibility (20-30m). Oct: sweet spot -- warm enough to swim, lower crowds/prices than Jul-Aug. Jun & Sep-Oct: best value, 20-30% cheaper, no queues. Avoid Jul-Aug (French school holidays, packed) and Dec-Mar (cyclone risk, wet season).

Dec-Feb: best overall, warm/long days, ideal hiking, but busiest (esp Christmas/NY). Nov & Mar: shoulder, equally good weather, quieter trails -- Nov especially recommended. Sep-Nov & Mar-May: mild, colorful, fewer crowds. Jun-Aug: winter, best for skiing/snowboarding/hot pools/glaciers.

Nov-May: dry season, best overall, sunny, 77-82F. Dec-Feb: best specifically, dry season starting before peak heat. Mar-May: driest/hottest (up to 100F coastal). Apr-Sep: best consistent surf; Feb better for beginner surfers (smaller waves). Avoid Sep-Oct: heaviest rain. May-Oct: budget season, lowest prices.

Nov-Apr: dry season, best overall -- Nov-Jan optimal (dry+relatively cool, though dusty Saharan harmattan winds). Feb-Apr: hot, 103-110F. Aug-Oct: best for festivals -- harvest celebrations nationwide. Climate varies hugely by region (arid Sahel north vs humid south, rains start Feb-Mar in south).

May-Oct: dry season, best overall, cooler/less rain. Jul-Aug: high season but never crowded -- widely cited as best months. Sep-Oct: shoulder, fewer tourists + pleasant weather + more availability. Jul-Oct: excellent whale watching. Nov-Apr: wetter/hotter/more humid, but fewer crowds/better deals.

May-Oct broadly good; Apr-Jun & Sep-Oct: best overall, mild (15-25C) -- Sep often cited as single best month. Jun & Sep: warm days + fewer crowds, great around Lake Ohrid/mountains. Spring: alpine flora; autumn: grape harvest + leaf color. Jul-Aug: busiest, 30-35C. Nov-Feb: smog settles over Skopje, but good for skiing/winter culture.

Dec-May (esp Jan-Apr, best Feb-Mar): dry season, best overall, sunny/pleasant/lower humidity, good beach/hiking/culture conditions. Avoid typhoon season May-Dec, esp Aug-Nov. Busiest/priciest: Jul, Dec, Mar.

Jun-Aug: best overall, long daylight/midnight sun, warm for fjords/Arctic, low precip. May: lower rainfall, good shoulder. Sep: crisp air, dramatic light, crowds gone. Nov-Mar: best Northern Lights + snow activities, Jan-Feb coldest/quietest. North best in fall (thinner crowds, foliage); south best May-Aug (warmest, greenest).

Oct-Mar: best overall, warm days/pleasant nights, virtually no rain. Oct: great for Al Hajar Mountains hiking + Wahiba Sands desert. Mar-May & Sep-Nov: also recommended, minimal rain. Jun-Aug: best for turtle watching (Ras Al Jinz) despite heat (104F+). Avoid May-Aug generally: oppressively hot/hazy.

May-Oct broadly good, Oct standout: clear skies, mild, accessible, no monsoon/heat extremes. Northern Pakistan (mountains): best May-Nov. Southern Pakistan (lowlands/bazaars/archaeology): best Nov-Mar. Avoid Aug: monsoon nationwide. Winter: much of landscape snowed in, hard to access.

Dec-Apr: dry season, best overall, sunny/calm seas -- Feb-Apr clearest skies specifically. Best diving/snorkeling visibility + predictable drift-dive currents in this window. Nov-Dec: shoulder, moderate rain, lighter crowds. Jun-Sep: best value/budget. Typhoon-free zone, stable temps year-round (77-86F).

Mar-May & Sep-Nov: best overall, warm/sunny/dry, cool nights, good for hiking. Mar-Apr: wildflowers, best walking season. Religious festivals (Christmas, Easter, Ramadan) draw pilgrims/crowds and shape the best time depending on interest -- Christmas/Easter high season, summer draws festivals + diaspora visitors. Avoid Jun-Aug: notably hot; Dec-Feb: wet/cold.

Mid Dec-Apr: dry season, best overall, hot/sunny (~89F), best for Canal tours/beaches/mountain hiking. Feb-Apr: lowest rainfall specifically. Early Dec & late Apr: shoulder, avoids peak crowds and heaviest rain. May-mid Dec: green/wet season, cheapest, still very visitable, especially early on.

Oct-Mar (summer): best, warmest, driest, longest days -- but Dec busiest, book ahead. Mar-May (autumn) & Sep-Nov (spring): off-peak, warm+lower humidity, quieter, wildflowers, less-crowded trails. Jun-Aug (winter): quiet, best for spotting endangered Norfolk green parrot.

May-Oct: dry season, best overall, clear skies, low humidity. May-Jul: least rain. Apr & Nov: shoulder, cheaper, rains just ending/starting. Avoid Dec-Apr: monsoon, 500mm+ rain, washed-out roads/landslides in mountains, some lodges close.

May-Sep (southern winter): best overall, mild/dry, comfortable for Asuncion + Jesuit Missions. Sep-early Dec: cooler, cheaper fares. Mar-May & Sep-Nov: comfortable shoulder for cities+outdoors. Dry winter also best for Gran Chaco wildlife/Mennonite colonies. Avoid Dec-Feb: hottest (low-mid 30sC).

May-Oct: dry season, best overall for trekking -- Jun-Aug peak (Andes trekking, Machu Picchu, Amazon wildlife) but crowded. Apr-May & Sep-Nov: shoulder, good weather + fewer tourists. Highlands/Machu Picchu: best May-Sep. Amazon/coast: best Dec-Apr (opposite pattern). Wettest: Jan-Feb.

Dec-Feb: best overall, most accessible, 75-88F. Nov & May: shoulder, either side of rains, fewer crowds. Dry season broadly Nov-May (25-30C, less humid); wetter Jun-Oct (localized -- 7,000+ islands means bad weather rarely affects everywhere at once). Avoid Mar-May: hot/humid for sightseeing; typhoons possible Aug-Jan.

Jan-Mar (southern summer): warmest/sunniest, calmer seas. Apr-Sep (dry season, also most frequent vessel visits): mild/comfortable -- practically defines feasibility given remote boat-only access. No real high/low season; Jun-Aug slightly busier/pricier.

May-Oct broadly good; May: best spring pick, long days, sunny, mountain hiking + wildflowers. Sep-Oct: fall favorite, cultural season starts, hotel pressure eases. Jun-Aug: peak, warm (75F), crowded Baltic coast resorts. Avoid Jul-Aug if seeking quiet -- go May/Jun or Sep/Oct instead. Dec: festive, lovely for holiday charm.

Sep-Oct: best overall, summer heat softens, still warm/dry, wine harvest. Mar-May: spring bloom, before crowds -- Mar specifically good weather + fewer tourists. Jun: Lisbon's Festas de Lisboa + Porto's Festa de Sao Joao, lively but crowded/hot. Winter (south): thin crowds, low prices, mild weather, good for outdoor activities.

Mid Apr-Jun: best overall, milder, fewer crowds, just after winter peak/before rains. Dec-Mar: winter high season, golden sun, 70-83F, but most crowded/expensive -- carnivals in Dec/Jan add cultural draw at a price premium. Jul-Nov: cheapest, but hurricane season (peak Jun-Nov).

Nov-Apr: best overall, mild (68-95F), best for Doha sightseeing/desert/coast. Oct-Dec & Feb-Apr: shoulder, pleasantly mild (68-86F). Oct-Apr: prime sports season (F1, tennis, MotoGP, golf). Jun-Aug: scorching (104F+) but fewer tourists + lower hotel prices, everything air-conditioned.

May-Oct (dry, southern winter): best overall, ~25C, low rain, best hiking (Piton de la Fournaise) + Jul-Oct whale watching off Saint-Gilles. May,Jun,Sep,Oct: equally pleasant but less crowded. Nov-Apr: warmer/humid, best for beach/swimming/diving -- but avoid Jan-Mar, cyclone risk.

Mid May-mid Sep: best overall, warm/sunny. Apr-May: best scenery + ideal temps, occasional early rain. Sep: best for autumn color + mushroom season, still warm. Jul-Aug: hottest (30C+), best beach window (Jul 15-Aug 30) but priciest/crowded. Dec: good for skiing + castle/old-town winter atmosphere.

Jun-Sep & Dec-Feb: dry seasons, best overall, easiest hiking/gorilla trekking, lowest malaria risk. Jun-Sep: peak gorilla-trekking season -- book permits/lodges well ahead. Dec-Feb: similar conditions, fewer visitors. Mar-May & Nov (rainy seasons): best for chimp tracking, lush/green, lower prices/crowds.

Mid Dec-Apr: dry season, best overall, warm/sunny/low humidity -- also Christmas Village + St Barts Music Festival. Mar-Apr: shoulder, high season ending, fewer crowds/lower prices. Late spring & late fall: best value. Avoid Sep: highest hurricane risk + wettest month.
Nov-Mar (austral summer): best overall, warmer/drier, 20-27C. Dec-Feb: sunniest, least rain. Jan-Mar: whale shark season. Apr-Oct: cooler/wetter but fewer tourists, quieter experience.

Feb-May (esp Mar-Apr): driest, best overall, sunny/warm, avoids Jul-Nov hurricane season. Dec-Apr: peak season, incl. Carnival -- crowded/pricier. Jun: good value alternative, warm, moderate rain, fewer crowds.

Dec-Mar: best overall, ~81F, ideal beach weather -- but peak season/pricier. Feb-May: driest window. Late Apr-early Jun: sweet spot, misses winter crowds + high prices, just before heavy rains. Early May: Jazz & Arts Festival. Jul: two-week Carnival. Avoid Sep-Oct: peak rainfall.

Dec-Apr: dry season, best overall, warm/sunny/little rain -- Jan-Feb peak prices. May: smart shoulder pick, still hot/beach-friendly, crowds ease, better value. Feb-Mar: French-side Carnival, two weeks of music/costumes/parades. Avoid Jun-Nov: rainy/hurricane season, many hotels close.

Jul-Sep: best overall, mildest (~63F highs), Bastille Day (mid-Jul), Basque Festival (Aug, pelota/dance), Miquelon Seafood Festival (mid-Aug). Early Sep: fewer crowds, still comfortable. Spring: slow thaw, limited services, too cold for most outdoor activity.

Feb-Apr: driest, best overall, 81-86F. Dec-Apr: peak season, warm/dry, most tour options -- but crowded/pricier. May-Jun & Nov: best value, rates drop, only slightly wetter than peak. Jul-Oct: hurricane season, thinnest crowds/lowest prices, rarely majorly impacted given southerly location.

May-Oct (dry season, esp Jun-Sep): best overall weather, sunny, good snorkeling visibility. Sep-Oct: sweet spot -- fewer tourists, still dry, cheaper. Nov-Apr: wet, hot/humid, but best for powerful waterfalls.
Spring & fall: best overall, comfortable + fewer crowds. Jul-Aug: hottest, driest, peak season, largest crowds. Dec: Christmas Market, cold/quiet, some limited hours.

Two dry seasons -- Dec-Feb & Jun-Sep: best overall, sunny, good snorkeling/diving visibility. Dec-Feb: turtle nesting (mid-Nov-early Feb, hatching into Mar). Jun-Sep: humpback whales (late Jul-Oct), Independence Day Jul 12 with carnival atmosphere. Oct-Nov & Mar-May (wet): quiet beaches, best for orchids, fewer tourists.

Nov-Feb: best overall, mild, only recognized tourist season, numerous festivals/events. Spring & fall: comfortable, good outdoor activities. Jun-Aug: too hot for most, though Red Sea coast still appealing + most affordable. Avoid Ramadan (dates vary) for non-Muslim travelers -- country focused on fasting/prayer.

Nov-Feb: dry season, best overall, coolest, best wildlife viewing. Nov-May: dry season broadly, warming from Feb on. May: Saint-Louis Jazz Festival, world-famous. Dakar art biennales during dry season. Avoid late Jun-Sep: rainy, humid, unpredictable rural travel/washed-out roads.

Mar-May & Sep-Oct: best overall, mild, pleasant countryside. Spring: cool, less crowded, best if rain-tolerant. Early Jul: EXIT Festival draws big crowds (otherwise no huge tourist influx even in summer). Sep: warm + reduced crowds + lower prices. Winter: harsh/cold but good for skiing/winter city breaks.

Apr-May & Oct-Nov: best overall, less windy, mild, best diving visibility (up to 30m). May-Sep (SE trade winds): cooler/drier, best hiking (Morne Seychellois) + sailing. Nov-Mar (NW trade winds): warmer. Avoid Dec, Jan, Jul, Aug for crowds -- shoulder months better value.

Nov-Apr: dry season, best overall, low humidity (esp Dec-Feb), beaches/forests fully accessible. Nov: often cited as best month. Dec-Jan: popular, hot but manageable. Jan-Feb: Harmattan season, hazy/dusty skies. Sep-Oct: good balance at tail end of rains, fewer tourists, fresh landscapes. Avoid Jul-Aug: heaviest rain, flooding/access issues.

Mar-Aug: best overall, least frequent rainfall -- though tropical climate means very consistent temps/humidity year-round, visitable any time. Jun-Jul: hottest, peak season/school holidays, higher prices. Watch for Chinese New Year + F1 Night Race dates: rooms booked out/pricier.

Dec-Apr: dry/sunny season, best overall, peak prices Jan-Feb -- Heineken Regatta + Carnival add cultural draw. May-Jun & Nov-mid Dec: best value, lower rain risk, better rates. Avoid summer/early fall: many hotels close, hurricane risk.

Apr-May & Sep-Oct: best overall, sweet spot -- Sep top month, mild/clear/fewer tourists. May: warms quickly, pleasant. Jun-Aug: warm but can bring high rainfall/storms; mid-Jun-Oct best for High Tatras hiking. Dec-Mar/Apr: ski season.

Jun-Aug: best overall, warm/clear, mild Adriatic, fewer crowds than nearby countries -- Jul-Aug best for high-alpine Triglav hiking. May-Jun & Sep-Oct: fewer crowds, still excellent, May great for road-tripping, Sep good for summiting Triglav + wine tastings (Goriska Brda etc). Dec-Mar: Julian Alps/Karavanke ski season.

Jun-Sep: dry season, best overall, predictable weather, calm waters, great diving/snorkeling/hiking. Jul-Sep specifically best. May-Jun & Oct-Nov: shoulder, better value, prices/crowds drop. Avoid Dec-Apr: wet season, heavy rain, rough seas, reduced visibility, cyclone risk (though direct Honiara hits rare).

May-Sep (dry winter, east): best for safari/wildlife, thinned vegetation concentrates animals at waterholes. Oct-Mar (dry summer, Cape Town/coast): best for beaches, warm/clear/long days. Jun-Nov: best whale watching (peak Sep). Apr-Jun & Sep-Oct: shoulder, better prices. Sep: good all-rounder -- combines regions + newborn game + whales.

Mar-May & Sep-Nov: best overall, moderate temps, comfortable humidity. Mar-May (esp Apr): cherry blossoms, very popular/crowded/pricier. Oct: widely considered best single month -- cool/dry, peak autumn foliage. Jun-Aug: hot/humid but best hiking conditions away from cities. Avoid Dec-Feb: bitterly cold.

Apr-Jun & Sep-Oct: best overall, pleasant temps, fewer crowds -- fall specifically well-balanced with harvest festivals. Mar-May: mild, rain rare, nature blooming. Jun-Aug: hot (25-35C), best beach weather, crushing crowds/high prices. Winter: quiet museums, surprisingly sunny afternoons, cheapest flights Nov & Feb.

Dec-mid Apr: best overall (south/west coasts), hot/sunny, driest, but also high season/pricier. May: quiet sweet spot between monsoons. May-Aug: best for east coast (Arugam Bay surf) while south/west get Yala monsoon rain. Nov-Dec: worst for east/north (Maha monsoon peak).

Late Aug-mid Nov (esp Oct): driest/sunniest, best overall. Feb-Mar: secondary dry window. Turtle viewing: late Feb-May (leatherbacks into Aug). Rainforest wildlife: best in dry season (lower water = animals more visible). Avoid May-Aug: wettest, interior flooding, worse road access.

May-Sep: main season, best overall -- Jul-Aug best for wildlife/polar bear spotting, ice melted, active wildlife. Apr 20-Aug 22: midnight sun (no sunset). Oct-Feb: polar night, best Northern Lights viewing. Mar-May: best for skiing/snowmobiling, transition to endless daylight.

Jun-Aug: peak season, best overall, long daylight, mildest temps, best for outdoor activities -- crowded/pricier. Apr-May & Sep-Nov: shoulder, mild + fewer crowds, Apr best for spring flowers. Dec-Feb: winter wonderland cities (Stockholm, Kiruna), Christmas markets, Northern Lights in the north.

Apr-Oct broadly good (Dec-Mar for skiing). Mid-late spring: best overall, esp for cities (Zurich/Lucerne/Geneva), fewer tourists/better prices. Jul-Aug: peak, best hiking/swimming/paddleboarding, most popular/crowded. Early fall (Sep-Oct): crisp, vibrant foliage, ideal hiking. Dec-Mar: peak ski season, groomed pistes.

Oct-Nov & Apr: best overall, lowest rain chance, pleasant. Mar-May: comfortable temps islandwide, though a 2-3wk 'Plum Rain' monsoon usually starts in May. Oct-Nov: pleasantly warm days, cool nights, low rain. Avoid May-Sep: rainiest/hottest, typhoon season.

Apr-Jun & Sep-Oct: best overall -- May or Sep sweet spot for combining mountains+cities. Pamir Highway: best late May-late Sep (snowbound outside that window). Jun-Aug: high season for Pamir/Fann Mountains trekking, but lowland cities uncomfortably hot. Sep: heat eases, most mountain passes still open. Spring: wildflower meadows, snowmelt.

Jun-Oct: dry season, best overall wildlife viewing, animals concentrate at water sources. Jun-Oct: Great Migration in Serengeti, Aug-Sep best for Mara River crossings. Jan-Feb: wildebeest calving season. Jul-Sep: best for Zanzibar beaches, cloudless skies. Nov-May (green season): best birdwatching.

Nov-Feb: best overall, cooler/drier, ideal beaches+heritage sites. West coast: best in winter (best diving/snorkeling). East coast/Gulf of Thailand: best Apr-Sep (opposite pattern). May-Aug: quieter, lighter showers, budget-friendly. Three seasons: wet May-Oct, cool Nov-Feb, hot Mar-May.

May-Nov (dry season): best overall, hot/dry/clear skies. Jul-Sep: peak, best weather, clearest water, best Mt Ramelau trekking. Oct-Nov: still dry, whale season begins. Avoid Dec-Apr: heavy rain, flood-like conditions, difficult travel. Diving good year-round (water stays 26-28C).

Nov-Feb: harmattan dry season, best overall, lower humidity/cooler nights. Dec-Jan: most favorable specifically (22-28C), though harmattan brings Saharan dust haze. Dry season also best for wildlife viewing in national parks. Avoid Mar-Apr: hottest; May-Oct rains (with a brief Jul/Sep respite in the south).

Mid May-Oct: driest, best overall, calmer seas (important given access is a 24-36hr boat trip from Samoa). Jun-Aug: peak season. Apr-May & Sep-Oct: shoulder, lower prices/smaller crowds. Avoid Nov-Apr: wet + cyclone season, rougher seas. Extremely low visitor numbers year-round (under 150/yr).

May-Oct: dry season, best overall. May, Jun, Nov specifically: warm with less rain than deep wet season. Jul-Sep: best whale watching + best diving visibility. Avoid Nov-Apr wet season, esp Jan-Mar cyclone risk. Dry season is priciest -- book tours/rooms early.

Jan-May: dry season, best overall, low humidity/rain. Jan-Mar: best specifically -- Carnival (huge cultural draw), blooming trees, sunshine, cool nights. Mar: sea turtle hatching begins + migratory birds. Sep: 'petit carem' -- brief sunny respite mid rainy season, low-season rates. Apr-May & Sep-Oct: good shoulder blend of culture+manageable crowds.

Apr-May & Sep-Oct (shoulder): best overall, mild, uncrowded ruins. Mar-Jun: spring, 16-20C, pleasant. Jun-Sep: hot, best for sun-seekers/beaches, busier. Dec-Feb: cheapest, near-deserted archaeological sites (El Djem, Bulla Regia), good for cultural tours; south stays warm.

Apr-Jun & Sep-Oct: best overall, comfortable temps, low rain, blossoms (spring) / foliage (fall). Jul-Aug: hot inland (30C+) but great for Aegean/Mediterranean coast beaches. Dec-Feb: skiing (Uludag, Palandoken). May & Sep: best for fewer tourists, more local feel.

Mar-May & Sep-Nov: best overall, 23-35C, comfortable for historical sites/desert/mountains. Mar: Nowruz (Persian New Year) festival, major cultural highlight, brief desert bloom. Autumn: good for desert camping + ancient ruins. Avoid summer: 40-50C in desert; winter: extremely cold.

Dec-Apr: peak season, best overall weather, dry/sunny/warm. Jan-Apr: humpback whale migration. May, Jun, Nov: shoulder, good weather balance + lower prices, slightly more rain in May. Avoid Jun-Nov: hurricane season, risk highest mid-Aug-Sep.

May-Oct (dry season, esp Jun-Sep): best overall, sunny, calm seas, best snorkeling/diving visibility + lagoon boat travel. May & Oct: shoulder, good weather + fewer tourists. Avoid Oct-Mar: westerly gales, heavy rain.

Nov-Mar: best overall, sunny not too hot, peak beach weather -- but busiest. Nov & Mar: best value, near-perfect weather + fewer crowds. May-Aug: extreme heat, but lower hotel prices + fewer crowds, good for indoor/mall-heavy trips.

Late Mar-early Jun & Sep-Nov: best overall shoulder seasons, warm/dry + fewer crowds than summer, spring flowers or autumn color. Jun-Aug: peak, warmest (15-25C), most crowded/priciest. Jan: cheapest month, post-holiday price drop.

Apr-Oct broadly good, varies enormously by region. Spring & fall (shoulder): best overall combo of fewer crowds + comfortable weather -- Sep especially strong (Northeast fall foliage begins). Jun-Aug: peak/family travel season, crowded national parks/beaches; West Coast hot/dry Jul-Aug, East Coast humid. Winter: regional -- ski country vs. weather-disrupted flights/roads elsewhere. Best month varies hugely by destination (e.g. San Francisco: Sep-Nov; New England: May-Jun & Oct).

Dec-May: best overall, dry/sunny, ~78F, low rain -- Dec-Mar is high season. Apr-Jun: sweet spot -- dry season ending, rates drop, pre-hurricane season, still mild. Avoid Jun-Nov: hurricane season, though fewer crowds/lower prices.

Nov-Mar: best overall (southern summer), warmest/driest, peak season. Dec-Feb: liveliest -- Punta del Este beaches, Montevideo's month-long Carnival (world's longest) in Jan. Mid Nov-mid Dec & Feb-Mar: shoulder, warm + good hotel value, ocean warm into Apr. Jun-Sep (winter): quiet, good for spotting southern right whales. Sep-Nov (spring): rising temps, coastal restaurants reopen, good pre-crowd window.

Mar-mid Jun & Sep-Oct: best overall, avoids extreme continental summers/winters. Mar-Jun: warm/dry, brief desert bloom. Late Sep-Oct: cooler (20sC), low rain, best for sightseeing, market harvest season. Both are peak/crowded -- winter is quiet but cold.

Apr-Oct (dry season): best overall, comfortable (64-82F), low rain. May, early Jun, Sep: best specifically -- good weather + smaller crowds (Jun-Aug is peak AU/NZ school-holiday season). Apr-Jun: naghol land-diving ritual on Pentecost Island, major cultural draw. Avoid Nov-Mar: hot/wet/humid, cyclone risk peaks Jan-Feb.

Nov-Feb (winter low season, except around Dec 8-Jan 6 holidays): best overall for smaller crowds -- Jan-Feb most peaceful, can experience Sistine Chapel without heavy crowds. Apr-Oct: peak season, warm but heaviest tourist influx/longest waits. Any season: visit right at opening (7:30am) and Tue/Wed/Thu for shortest lines.

Dec-Apr: dry season, best overall for Caribbean coast/Los Roques/Andes/Gran Sabana trekking -- Jan-Feb driest/most comfortable. Exception: Angel Falls needs the rainy season (roughly Jun-Nov) to be at full flow -- at peak dry season (~Mar) it's reduced to a trickle. Wet season (May-Oct) also good if rain-tolerant: lush rainforests, full waterfalls.

Nov-Apr: best overall (least rain nationally), but climate varies hugely by region. North: best Mar-Apr & Sep-Nov. Central: dry season Feb-Aug best, but typhoons Aug-Nov. South: dry season Nov-Apr best. May, Jun, Sep: best for avoiding crowds nationally.

May-Oct (dry season, esp Jun-Aug): best overall, low humidity/rain, calm water for snorkeling/diving/hiking. Jun-Aug: peak, priciest/busiest. May & Sep: best value, cheapest months. Avoid Nov-Apr: rainy (Jan-Feb wettest), cyclone risk Nov-mid May.

Nov-Mar (esp Nov-Mar core, bearable Nov-May broadly): best overall, 20-25C, manageable for desert travel. Feb: best reported wildlife sightings; Mar-Apr also good (cooler = more daytime animal activity). Dakhla coast: windy 300 days/year, big kitesurfing draw regardless of season. Avoid Jun-Aug: 40C+, not recommended for desert excursions.

May-Oct (dry season): best overall wildlife viewing, mild days. Jul-Oct: peak safari season (South Luangwa, Kafue, Lower Zambezi). Jun-Aug: best for Victoria Falls (strong flow, not obscured by spray). Mar: strong for birdwatching, migratory species departing. Dec-Apr (green season): lush scenery, best photography light, but many camps closed.

May-Oct (dry season): best overall for game viewing, low malaria risk, animals gather at water. May-Sep specifically best for national parks/wildlife. Victoria Falls: most dramatic Apr-May (post-rainy-season full flood) though spray can obscure view; Jun-Sep best balance of strong flow + clear viewing. Nov, Mar, Apr (shoulder): lush/green, migratory birds, baby animals, lower prices.
